note:
BH-9468: a row that BR_ROW_MAX_SECS stopped this many ticks in a row runs uncapped the next time it is dispatched (`row cap:

/ runs uncapped this tick`), so a row whose reads always take longer than the cap is late, never starved. The count lives in state/blocked-resolver/.row-carry[-].tsv and drops when the row runs to an end or leaves the candidate list. 0 = off (no exemption): a row slower than the cap is stopped every tick (the starvation risk). Settings row: lane.blocked-resolver.br_row_carry_max.
